title: A new account sees the Welcome to Tracy popup once; closing or its last button records the welcome hint and it never shows again; the button opens Add site
steps: S1: Run the onboard mount tests (Welcome cases) and the tracy-web welcome scenes door tests.
expect: Every test passes: unseen account sees the popup, x/Escape and the last scene button record `welcome` and it stays closed after reload, the button completes the first run and opens /new/?tab=tracy:add-site, the scenes door is signed-in only and serves only its own files.
evidence: 167/167 onboard tests and 5/5 scenes door tests on 25/10/2026
fence: The first-run popup's show-once rule and the door that serves its scenes
